headline: RBI to hold ₹75,000 crore 3-day VRR auction under LAF on November 27, 2026
summary_points: RBI will conduct a 3-day Variable Rate Repo (VRR) auction under LAF on Friday, November 27, 2026.
The decision follows a review of current and evolving near-term liquidity conditions.
Operational guidelines remain the same as in Press Release 2021-2022/1572 dated January 20, 2022.

rows: As per Press Release 2021-2022/1572 dated January 20, 2022

who_is_affected: Banks and other LAF-eligible participants, and treasury teams tracking short-term liquidity and money market rates.
action_required: Eligible participants wishing to bid should do so within the 09:30-10:00 AM window on November 27, 2026, following the existing operational guidelines.

social.linkedin:
RBI has announced a 3-day Variable Rate Repo (VRR) auction under the Liquidity Adjustment Facility (LAF) for Friday, November 27, 2026.

Key details:
- Notified amount: ₹75,000 crore
- Tenor: 3 days
- Bidding window: 09:30 AM to 10:00 AM
- Reversal date: Monday, November 30, 2026

The central bank said the move follows a review of current and evolving liquidity conditions in the near term. Operational guidelines will be the same as those in Press Release 2021-2022/1572 dated January 20, 2022.

For treasury and finance teams, this is a signal to watch short-term liquidity and money market conditions closely, especially across the weekend reversal cycle.

Please verify with the official RBI press release (2026-2027/1573) before acting.
